exits.title: If you apply anyway
steps: The checks don't suggest applying for either goal. If you still want to, write your reason in the journal first.
Use the listing-day rule: decide before Wed 28 Oct what you'll do if it opens above or below ₹1,119.

disclaimer: A learning aid worked out by fixed rules, not advice. Only apply with money you won't need soon, and decide for yourself.
